```python
log.info("invoice_refunded", invoice_id=invoice.id)
```

It uses structlog with a snake_case event name, the same way `invoices.py` logs and as the project's logging convention says. The line comes after the amount check, so it only logs refunds that go through, not ones rejected with `ValueError`. I haven't run anything to check it.

The project already had notes about structlog, so I didn't save any new ones.
